Just trying to keep up with the kids!

Another excellent day of spring skiing can be had in the Rendezvous and at Sun Mountain. Conditions will be at their best in the morning before things warm up too much. We are no longer grooming Winthrop trails and Mazama is most likely done as well. Today looks to be one of the sunniest days for awhile so grab your brightest aloha shirt and hit the trails! We'll see you out there. Thank you for supporting our operations with your pass purchase. 

Seniors 75+ plus, we'd love your input on what we do. Please take our senior engagment survey here, and thank you for your time.

Glide of the Day:
